sources.text: Synthetic explicit GQA attention/residual block: separate Q/K/V projections, append cache, causal useful versus rectangular executed attention, vector softmax proxy, row-parallel output and residual. BF16 tensors/matrix, FP32 vector proxy. No norm, RoPE, MLP, embedding/head, inference, measured kernel or full language-model claim.

Primary topology/cache/partial softmax merge and stage-transfer concepts only. Authored contiguous PCP chunks, fixed-capacity contiguous DCP slots, three-reduction stable merge, artificial rates and standalone attention stages are explicit mathematical choices, not a literal vLLM kernel/cache implementation or full model. Two consecutive synthetic GQA attention/residual blocks on distinct physical stage devices. Each stage owns its full weights and K/V state; a single microbatch traverses both stages serially. No claim of steady-state pipeline overlap or a full language model. The original GQA local equations and materialized buffers remain explicit. BF16 intermediate activation is sent once, without dividing payload by PP size. Network HBM/reduction arithmetic are unknown, not zero.

localCost.description: Explicit local logical/allocated axes and physical storage bytes. BF16 append writes only the new K/V tile; other buffers read/written once including declared quantization auxiliaries. Replicated K/V may duplicate projection work and read the complete local cache pool. No automatic conversion or network HBM arithmetic.
